title: Configurations and eligibility (registry/eligibility.yaml)
description: Which SoC configurations are registered (walked, T0-tested nightly, shown on the dashboard), which are frozen or silicon, and (Phase 4) which default branches the bot may auto-merge into. Changed only through a merge request to the registry's protected main. Owner: registry loader. B2, B5, D2, H1, E3, E5.

auto_merge.description: Phase 4 (E2, E3, E5). Component id -> change classes the bot may auto-merge into that component's default branch, once shadow mode has ended. Absent or empty in v1.

id.description: B2. Also the <config> segment of keep/<config>/<component> tags (C10).

component.description: B2: must be a catalogue component of class soc_ref or example.

ref.description: B2: the branch or tag on the component's canonical host.

commit.description: Required when frozen. The walker, B5 and T0 always use this commit for a frozen configuration, whatever `ref` says: `ref` is then informational. A TAG that stops peeling to it raises a tag_moved alert (C10); a branch that moves on raises nothing.

errata_prefix.description: F1, F4: the id prefix of this configuration's errata (ETH-R0P0 gives ETH-R0P0-ERR-001). Required once the configuration has an erratum (README section 3 rule 11).

silicon.description: B5, F1, F4, C10 (silicon/<chip>-rNpM). A silicon configuration is always frozen.

upgrade_from.description: D2 upgrade-path clone: the previous release to upgrade from. Absent -> gate t0.clone.upgrade-path records SKIP with the reason.

t0_waivers.description: D2, D6 (GATE2 Q1, approved 2026-10-01): known T0 failures of a FROZEN configuration that can never be fixed in its tree. Each covers one item of one gate (README section 6): the item is shown amber with its reason and approver, and a gate whose every non-pass item is covered rolls up WAIVED instead of FAIL or UNVERIFIED. Any other failure is still FAIL, so a new red on a frozen tree stays visible. The runner never sees waivers: verdicts.tsv and the items files are unchanged and the raw verdict is stored beside the waived one. A waiver that matched nothing in an accepted run raises a `waiver_unused` alert. Uniqueness and gate rules: README section 3 rule 13.

t0_waiver.description: One waived T0 item. Matches the item of `gate` at `tree_path` whose result is `result` (result-bundle.schema.json gate_item). A `not-reached` item below a covered item of the same gate is covered by it (it was not reached because of the waived item). No wildcards: each waiver names one item.

gate.description: A configuration gate that judges pins. Never t0.infra.probe or t0.runner.hardened (they judge the job, not the tree), never a t0.registry.* gate (the registry is not frozen), and never a gate's .negctl (D6: a control that did not fire is never waived).

reason.description: Why this item can never pass in this frozen tree, and what would retire the waiver.

approved_by.description: The login of the person who approved the waiver. The registry merge request is the record.
